entries.title: Proverbs 25:1
segments: ¶These also [are] proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied:

entries.title: Proverbs 25:2
segments: ¶[It is] the glory of God to conceal a matter, But the glory of kings [is] to search out a matter.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:3
segments: [As] the heavens for height and the earth for depth, So the heart of kings [is] unsearchable.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:4
segments: ¶Take away the dross from silver, And it will go to the silversmith [for] jewelry.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:5
segments: Take away the wicked from before the king, And his throne will be established in righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:6
segments: ¶Do not exalt yourself in the presence of the king, And do not stand in the place of the great;

entries.title: Proverbs 25:7
segments: For [it is] better that he say to you, "Come up here," Than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, Whom your eyes have seen.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:8
segments: ¶Do not go hastily to court; For what will you do in the end, When your neighbor has put you to shame?

entries.title: Proverbs 25:9
segments: Debate your case with your neighbor, And do not disclose the secret to another;

entries.title: Proverbs 25:10
segments: Lest he who hears [it] expose your shame, And your reputation be ruined.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:11
segments: ¶A word fitly spoken [is like] apples of gold In settings of silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:12
segments: [Like] an earring of gold and an ornament of fine gold [Is] a wise rebuker to an obedient ear.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:13
segments: ¶Like the cold of snow in time of harvest [Is] a faithful messenger to those who send him, For he refreshes the soul of his masters.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:14
segments: ¶Whoever falsely boasts of giving [Is like] clouds and wind without rain.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:15
segments: ¶By long forbearance a ruler is persuaded, And a gentle tongue breaks a bone.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:16
segments: ¶Have you found honey? Eat only as much as you need, Lest you be filled with it and vomit.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:17
segments: ¶Seldom set foot in your neighbor's house, Lest he become weary of you and hate you.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:18
segments: ¶A man who bears false witness against his neighbor [Is like] a club, a sword, and a sharp arrow.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:19
segments: ¶Confidence in an unfaithful [man] in time of trouble [Is like] a bad tooth and a foot out of joint.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:20
segments: ¶[Like] one who takes away a garment in cold weather, [And like] vinegar on soda, [Is] one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:21
segments: ¶If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat; And if he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

entries.title: Proverbs 25:22
segments: For [so] you will heap coals of fire on his head, And the LORD will reward you.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:23
segments: ¶The north wind brings forth rain, And a backbiting tongue an angry countenance.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:24
segments: ¶[It is] better to dwell in a corner of a housetop, Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:25
segments: ¶[As] cold water to a weary soul, So [is] good news from a far country.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:26
segments: ¶A righteous [man] who falters before the wicked [Is like] a murky spring and a polluted well.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:27
segments: ¶[It is] not good to eat much honey; So to seek one's own glory [is not] glory.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:28
segments: ¶Whoever [has] no rule over his own spirit [Is like] a city broken down, without walls.
